title: Reject whitespace-only card titles
text: Merged Kan PR #15 rejects whitespace-only card titles in create, rename and API paths. Three new article proposals are derived from its diff. Historical ContextQA analysis 19 completed with 0 passed and 15 failed; this is not a passing validation.

edits.after:
# Create a card

Open a board and start a new card. Enter a title with at least one non-whitespace character before submitting the form.

The create action stays disabled while the title is empty or contains only whitespace. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed before the card is submitted.

The API also rejects a blank title, so this rule applies even when a client bypasses the form.

## Validation status

These instructions are derived from Kan pull request #15. The historical ContextQA run failed at its shared login prerequisite before reaching this workflow. A reviewed capture from the target revision is required before this article is delivered.

# Rename a card

Open an existing card and edit its title. Use at least one non-whitespace character.

When the title is saved, leading and trailing whitespace is removed. If the edited title is blank after trimming, Kan restores the previous title and displays “Unable to update card” with “Card title cannot be empty.”

## Validation status

This behavior is supported by the source changes in Kan pull request #15. A fresh browser test of blank-title recovery and whitespace trimming is still required. The historical run failed before it reached the card workflow.

edits.after:
# Card title validation

Card creation requires a title. The card router trims leading and trailing whitespace, then validates that the title contains between 1 and 2,000 characters.

Update and duplicate operations accept an optional title. When supplied, it is subject to the same trimming and length validation. Omitting an optional title is distinct from supplying an empty string.

Whitespace-only titles fail validation before a database write. The focused router tests cover empty strings, spaces, tabs and newlines, and Unicode whitespace. The description-update tests verify that an omitted title remains optional.

## Validation status

This article is derived from the source and tests in Kan pull request #15. API unit-test results and browser workflow evidence are tracked separately. Browser evidence is still blocked by the shared login prerequisite.
